STS2_WINE_FOX_ADDONS_RELIC_GOURMET_APRON: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Regen[/gold] for each food in your potion slots.
An apron steeped in the smell of good cooking. Wear it, and it feels like you could taste every dish in the world.
STS2_WINE_FOX_ADDONS_RELIC_EMERALD_BADGE: The villagers use these to remember who is worth haggling with.
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.title: Lingering Aftertaste
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.description: During combat, whenever you use a [gold]Food[/gold], gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
WINE_FOX_REHEATED_AROMA_RUNE.flavor: A good dish deserves a second warming; even the aftertaste refuses to fade.
WINE_FOX_BASIC_CRAFT_INNATE_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Basic Crafting
WINE_FOX_BASIC_CRAFT_INNATE_RUNE.flavor: By the first hammer blow, both the materials and the plan are already in place.
WINE_FOX_INTERMITTENT_CHANTING_RUNE.flav: The chant crosses the gap, and no strength is lost along the way.
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.title: Myriad Depot
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.description: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]All-Item Warehouse[/gold] to your hand.
WINE_FOX_MYRIAD_DEPOT_RUNE.flavor: The shelves restock themselves; all that remains is to reach.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.title: Material Blast
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]1[/blue] damage to all enemies for every [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Materials[/gold] you have.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_BLAST_RUNE.flavor: Even scraps have a temper. The more you hoard, the louder they roar.
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Mechanical Saw
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.description: [gold]Mechanical Saw[/gold] consumes all [gold]Stress[/gold] and deals [blue]7[/blue] additional damage for each Stress consumed.
WINE_FOX_MECHANICAL_SAW_RUNE.flavor: The blade bites into every scrap of Stress, then throws it all back out.
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Stone Armor
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.description: [gold]Stone Brick Armor[/gold] no longer reduces [gold]Dexterity[/gold] at the start of your turn.
WINE_FOX_STONE_ARMOR_RUNE.flavor: Hard stone no longer wears away agility, leaving only dependable protection.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.title: Splinter Burst
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Material[/gold], deal [blue]5[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_SPARK_RUNE.flavor: Even the smallest scraps can sting when they fly.
WINE_FOX_SAWDUST_WARD_RUNE.title: Sawdust Ward
WINE_FOX_SAWDUST_WARD_RUNE.flavor: Sawdust on the shoulders still makes a decent cushion.
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Netherite Chestplate
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.descr: At the end of your turn, [gold]Netherite Chestplate[/gold] triples the total Block resolved from [gold]Plating[/gold].
WINE_FOX_NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE_RUNE.flavo: The thicker the plates, the steadier the stance.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.title: Reforged Scraps
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.descriptio: Whenever you spend [gold]Material[/gold], there is a [blue]50%[/blue] chance to refund the [gold]Material[/gold] spent.
WINE_FOX_MATERIAL_REFUND_RUNE.flavor: Unfinished material is not waste. It simply needs another turn at the forge.
WINE_FOX_STEAM_PRELUDE_RUNE.title: Steam Prelude
WINE_FOX_STEAM_PRELUDE_RUNE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Steam[/gold].
WINE_FOX_STEAM_PRELUDE_RUNE.flavor: The boiler has barely begun to roar; the charge is already underway.
WINE_FOX_ASSEMBLY_LINE_RUNE.title: Assembly Line
WINE_FOX_ASSEMBLY_LINE_RUNE.description: The first time you complete a [gold]Craft[/gold] each turn, draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
WINE_FOX_ASSEMBLY_LINE_RUNE.flavor: Once the process flows, neither hands nor tools need wait.
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Wireless Terminal
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.descript: [gold]Wireless Terminal[/gold] costs [blue]0[/blue]. Whenever you play [gold]Wireless Terminal[/gold], lose [red]1[/red] HP.
WINE_FOX_WIRELESS_TERMINAL_RUNE.flavor: Full signal, no queue for materials.
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.title: Traveling Trove
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random crafted [gold]Token[/gold] card to your hand. [gold]Sophisticated Backpack[/gold] upgrades are excluded.
WINE_FOX_TRAVELING_TROVE_RUNE.flavor: Every time the satchel opens, something unexpected tumbles out.
WINE_FOX_BACKPACK_COLLECTOR_RUNE.title: Backpack Collector
WINE_FOX_BACKPACK_COLLECTOR_RUNE.descrip: Obtain [gold]Bag of Preparation[/gold], [gold]Maid Backpack[/gold], and [gold]Sophisticated Backpack[/gold].
WINE_FOX_BACKPACK_COLLECTOR_RUNE.flavor: You can never have too many bags when traveling.
WINE_FOX_RICH_VEIN_RUNE.title: Rich Vein
WINE_FOX_RICH_VEIN_RUNE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]8[/blue] each of [gold]Plank[/gold], [gold]Cobblestone[/gold], [gold]Iron Ingot[/gold], and [gold]Diamond[/gold].
WINE_FOX_RICH_VEIN_RUNE.flavor: Before the first pick falls, the cart is already full.
WINE_FOX_LOGISTICS_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Logistics
WINE_FOX_LOGISTICS_RUNE.description: Obtain [gold]Logistics[/gold]. When [gold]Logistics[/gold] gives cards to another player, also give them [blue]1[/blue] copy of the [gold]Logistics[/gold] that was played.
WINE_FOX_LOGISTICS_RUNE.flavor: When the parcel arrives, the receipt is tucked under the lid too.
WINE_FOX_RECYCLING_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Recycling
WINE_FOX_RECYCLING_RUNE.description: Obtain [gold]Recycling[/gold]. [gold]Recycling[/gold] now Exhausts any number of other cards in your hand. For each card Exhausted, randomly gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Materials[/gold].
WINE_FOX_RECYCLING_RUNE.flavor: The more thoroughly something is taken apart, the more there is to use again.
WINE_FOX_UPGRADE_GEAR_RUNE.title: Upgrade: Upgrade Gear
WINE_FOX_UPGRADE_GEAR_RUNE.description: Obtain [gold]Upgrade Gear[/gold]. After [gold]Upgrade Gear[/gold] grants Block, choose up to [blue]2[/blue] cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to upgrade.
WINE_FOX_UPGRADE_GEAR_RUNE.flavor: Good tools never pick parts at random. They pick the ones that fit.
WINE_FOX_TOKEN_CARD_HOVER.title: Token Card
WINE_FOX_TOKEN_CARD_HOVER.description: Token cards are special cards generated by cards, relics, or powers. They usually do not enter your deck.
WINE_FOX_UPGRADE_RUNE.selectionFooter: When obtained, add 1 [gold]{CardName}[/gold] to your deck.
